subject: Post-call: LuminateAI reranker integration checklist & next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example>
To: Emma Li <emma@luminate.ai>, Martin Sørensen <martin@luminate.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: LuminateAI reranker integration checklist & next steps

Hi Emma / Martin,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the walkthrough of LuminateAI's search stack. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap:
- Current flow: candidate generation (BM25 + semantic embeddings) -> embeddings-based scoring -> baseline re-ranking (in-house logistic reg).
- Typical candidate pool: ~1k candidates per query at peak; daily corpus ~45M docs; average doc length ~350 tokens.
- Current SLAs: p95 latency target for search responses is ~150ms, throughput spikes to ~200 qps during peak windows.

Key technical asks from Redwood to proceed with a pairing workshop:
1) Share a small frozen sample of queries (50-200) + ground-truth clicks/labels (if available).
2) Confirm auth preference: API key vs mTLS (we can support both; mTLS preferred for pilot).
3) What latency window is acceptable for the reranker (e.g., add +30-120ms)? p95 budget?
4) Clarify where you'll apply the reranker: after candidate-gen (top_k=50) or earlier? Typical pattern we recommend: gen top_k=100 -> rerank top_k=10 for final results.
5) Evaluation metrics: useful to know which you care about (MRR@10, NDCG@5, Recall@100, pairwise win-rate).

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- Technical workshop (30-45m) next week with your ML engineer (Martin) + our solutions engineer (Kimberly). Goal: wire up SDK auth, run a smoke rerank on sample queries, and collect initial metrics.
- Deliverable after workshop: short pilot run (1k queries) with detailed per-query deltas and suggested top_k tuning.

I attached an "integration-checklist.xlsx" with the exact API calls we'd exercise during the workshop (SDK endpoints, param examples, structured-output examples). Also attached: a short SOW outline we can adjust.

Questions: can you confirm a time window for the workshop? Also, are you comfortable starting with an API key for the first pass or would you prefer us to provision mTLS creds?

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.example | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: integration-checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Emma Li <emma@luminate.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example>
Cc: Martin Sørensen <martin@luminate.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 18:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: LuminateAI reranker integration checklist & next steps

Thanks Ben — nice summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- We'll drop a 150-row sample of queries + click labels in the Drive link you suggested (I'll attach the CSV here). That's "evaluation-sample-queries.csv" (small, anonymized).
- We currently do API key for internal services; security would prefer mTLS for anything touching production docs. For the pilot, API key is fine.
- Latency tolerance for the reranker: we'd prefer p95 add <= 100ms. If we need more than that, we want to A/B test user impact first.
- We'll try your suggested pattern: candidate gen top_k=100 then rerank to top_k=10. Our baseline NDCG@10 is ~0.48 (offline) and online CTR change historically is noisy.

Available slots for the workshop: Wed 16 Mar 09:00-10:00 PT or Thu 17 Mar 13:00-14:00 PT. Martin will lead the engineering side.

Emma
VP Search, LuminateAI
emma@luminate.ai | +1 (206) 555-0107

Attachment: evaluation-sample-queries.csv (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example>
To: Emma Li <emma@luminate.ai>, Martin Sørensen <martin@luminate.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: LuminateAI reranker integration checklist & next steps

Great — appreciate the immediate turnaround and the sample. Booking Wed 16 Mar 09:00 PT works for us; I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

A couple technical notes for the workshop so Martin has what he needs ready: 
- SDK: we'll use Redwood Java SDK v0.9.3 for the smoke test; sample call will be the /v1/rerank endpoint with structured JSON output (score + explain spans). Example response schema we'll ask for: {"score": float, "explain": [ {"span": "...", "weight": float } ] } — simple JSON, we won't expect heavy provenance in the pilot.
- Auth: we'll start with API key. If you want mTLS for the pilot, please flag and we'll schedule cert exchange early in the week.
- Routing: suggest routing policy 'latency-first' for the smoke run so we measure p95 under a tight SLO; later test 'cost-balanced' for throughput runs.
- Top_k tuning: our recommended default is candidate_gen top_k=100 -> rerank top_k=10. For evaluation we'll sweep candidate k=[50,100,200] and rerank k=[5,10,20] and report MRR@10 and NDCG@5/10. We'll also calculate per-query delta vs your baseline.
- Acceptance thresholds: as a heuristic we can aim for +5% relative NDCG@10 or +3% absolute MRR uplift depending on KPI preference. We can adjust post-pilot.

I'll loop in Kimberly (solutions eng) and Marissa (CS) on the next note to align on pilot SOW and ops.

Thanks,

Ben
